purpose: Per-turn update contract for conversational feature/spec design.
required_checks: append one event for the turn
preserve exact tokens and negative constraints
update handoff cursor and next action
infer gui_related true/false for every new or updated design atom
do not create WorkNodes during PlanUnit indexing/node-readiness
forbidden: do not write canonical Plans unless compile was requested
do not update Spec_Lock or governance artifacts
do not read legacy working_ledger.md as active state
do not mark completion while open queues exist
do not ask the user to label GUI work; infer gui_related automatically
do not create WorkNodes or executable build tasks until the WorkNode compiler contract exists
